Consolidated sustainability statement prepared in accordance with ESRS as mandated by CSRD (EU 2022/2464). Reporting scope includes all consolidated entities of ČEZ Group (30+ subsidiaries) under operational control. Double materiality basis applied. All ESRS topical standards assessed as material. Comparative figures restated where methodology changed. External limited assurance by KPMG (ISAE 3000). Full electricity value chain: upstream (uranium procurement from Kazakhstan, Russia, Australia; domestic coal mining 8 Mt/year; gas procurement from Norway, Algeria, Russia; nuclear fuel fabrication by Westinghouse, Framatome; equipment manufacturing); own operations (31 power plants — nuclear 4,150 MW at Temelín and Dukovany, coal 4,500 MW at Počerady, Ledvice, Prunéřov, Tušimice, Mělník, Dětmarovice, gas 1,200 MW at Počerady, Kladno, hydro 2,000 MW incl. pumped storage Dlouhé Stráně 650 MW, solar 300 MW, wind 80 MW; distribution grid 180,000 km serving 3.6M metering points; energy trading); downstream (4.2M households, 200K+ corporate customers; energy services; district heating 1.5M customers; e-mobility 800+ charging stations; smart metering 650K+ installed). Regular engagement with 6 stakeholder groups: (1) Employees — works councils in all regions, collective bargaining 85% coverage, biennial engagement survey 72% participation (2025); (2) Investors — quarterly earnings calls, AGM, ESG roadshows (12 in 2025), CDP A-; (3) Regulators — ERÚ, Czech Ministry of Finance (70% state), EC, IAEA, EURATOM; (4) NGOs — Greenpeace, BirdLife, Czech Nature Conservancy, Hnutí DUHA; (5) Local communities — town halls in Ústí, Sokolov, Karviná, Just Transition consultations; (6) Customers — annual satisfaction survey (82%), complaint resolution (avg 5 days). Double materiality FY2025 per EFRAG IG1. Impact materiality: severity×likelihood 1-5. Financial materiality: magnitude×likelihood 1-5. Threshold ≥10 = material. 12 facilitated workshops, 60+ internal stakeholders, external benchmarking, media analysis. 25 material IROs identified. Validated by Sustainability Board and Audit Committee. External assurance by KPMG. 25 material IROs: E1 Climate (24): coal phase-out €3B+, EU ETS (€75-200/t), 6 GW renewables. E2 Pollution (20): air emissions, water pollution. E3 Water (14): cooling water, thermal. E4 Biodiversity (13): post-mining restoration. E5 Circular (11): ash utilization. S1 Workforce (22): coal transition, nuclear skills. S2 Value Chain (15): supplier labor. S3 Communities (12): Just Transition. G1 Business (16): anti-corruption, transparency. DD framework: (1) Environmental — EIA per 2011/92/EU, ISO 14001, EMAS; (2) Human rights — ILO, UNGP, UNICEF; (3) Anti-corruption — ISO 37001; (4) Nuclear safety — IAEA, WANO, ENSREG, SÚJB; (5) Supply chain — risk-based audits (120/year). Quarterly CSR Board reporting. ISO 31000:2018 ERM with 22 sustainability risks. Top: EU ETS carbon price (€75-200/t by 2035, €500M+/year impact), coal phase-out costs (€3B+), stranded assets (coal plants €3.5B), nuclear safety, renewable curtailment, regulatory uncertainty, uranium supply, workforce transition (3,000+ workers). Microsoft Sustainability Manager + SAP EHS, 30+ sites, SAP approval workflows, quarterly quality reviews, internal audit (10% sample), KPMG limited assurance (ISAE 3000, ISAE 3410 for GHG). COSO 2013 framework. ISO 9001:2015. Zero material weaknesses FY2025. ČEZ Clean Energy of Tomorrow 2030: 55%↓ GHG by 2030 (vs 2019: 31.1M tCO2e), 80% by 2040, net-zero 2050. Coal phase-out 2033 (8 plants, 4,500 MW). 6 GW renewables. Dukovany II nuclear (1,200 MW, CZK 180B, 2036). €15B+ investment 2024-2030. SBTi 1.5°C validated 2024. Internal carbon price €90/tCO2e. CEO 25% variable linked to climate. 120+ monitoring points. 3 contaminated sites (historical). ESRS Sustainability Report 2030

ČEZ, a. s.

LEI: 315T6Y5I4VD2QKRYI732 | Currency: EUR | Reporting period: 2030 | Generated: 2026-06-09

Taxonomy: EFRAG ESRS Set 1 XBRL (2023-12-22) | Namespace: https://xbrl.efrag.org/taxonomy/esrs/2023-12-22

ESRS 2 — General Disclosures

T0001_BasisOfPreparation

Consolidated sustainability statement prepared in accordance with ESRS as mandated by CSRD (EU 2022/2464). Reporting scope includes all consolidated entities of ČEZ Group (30+ subsidiaries) under operational control. Double materiality basis applied. All ESRS topical standards assessed as material. Comparative figures restated where methodology changed. External limited assurance by KPMG (ISAE 3000).

T0002_ValueChainDescription

Full electricity value chain: upstream (uranium procurement from Kazakhstan, Russia, Australia; domestic coal mining 8 Mt/year; gas procurement from Norway, Algeria, Russia; nuclear fuel fabrication by Westinghouse, Framatome; equipment manufacturing); own operations (31 power plants — nuclear 4,150 MW at Temelín and Dukovany, coal 4,500 MW at Počerady, Ledvice, Prunéřov, Tušimice, Mělník, Dětmarovice, gas 1,200 MW at Počerady, Kladno, hydro 2,000 MW incl. pumped storage Dlouhé Stráně 650 MW, solar 300 MW, wind 80 MW; distribution grid 180,000 km serving 3.6M metering points; energy trading); downstream (4.2M households, 200K+ corporate customers; energy services; district heating 1.5M customers; e-mobility 800+ charging stations; smart metering 650K+ installed).

T0003_StakeholderEngagementDescripti

Regular engagement with 6 stakeholder groups: (1) Employees — works councils in all regions, collective bargaining 85% coverage, biennial engagement survey 72% participation (2025); (2) Investors — quarterly earnings calls, AGM, ESG roadshows (12 in 2025), CDP A-; (3) Regulators — ERÚ, Czech Ministry of Finance (70% state), EC, IAEA, EURATOM; (4) NGOs — Greenpeace, BirdLife, Czech Nature Conservancy, Hnutí DUHA; (5) Local communities — town halls in Ústí, Sokolov, Karviná, Just Transition consultations; (6) Customers — annual satisfaction survey (82%), complaint resolution (avg 5 days).

T0004_MaterialityAssessmentProcess

Double materiality FY2025 per EFRAG IG1. Impact materiality: severity×likelihood 1-5. Financial materiality: magnitude×likelihood 1-5. Threshold ≥10 = material. 12 facilitated workshops, 60+ internal stakeholders, external benchmarking, media analysis. 25 material IROs identified. Validated by Sustainability Board and Audit Committee. External assurance by KPMG.

T0005_MaterialImpactsRisksOpportunit

25 material IROs: E1 Climate (24): coal phase-out €3B+, EU ETS (€75-200/t), 6 GW renewables. E2 Pollution (20): air emissions, water pollution. E3 Water (14): cooling water, thermal. E4 Biodiversity (13): post-mining restoration. E5 Circular (11): ash utilization. S1 Workforce (22): coal transition, nuclear skills. S2 Value Chain (15): supplier labor. S3 Communities (12): Just Transition. G1 Business (16): anti-corruption, transparency.

T0006_DueDiligenceProcess

DD framework: (1) Environmental — EIA per 2011/92/EU, ISO 14001, EMAS; (2) Human rights — ILO, UNGP, UNICEF; (3) Anti-corruption — ISO 37001; (4) Nuclear safety — IAEA, WANO, ENSREG, SÚJB; (5) Supply chain — risk-based audits (120/year). Quarterly CSR Board reporting.

T0007_RiskManagementProcess

ISO 31000:2018 ERM with 22 sustainability risks. Top: EU ETS carbon price (€75-200/t by 2035, €500M+/year impact), coal phase-out costs (€3B+), stranded assets (coal plants €3.5B), nuclear safety, renewable curtailment, regulatory uncertainty, uranium supply, workforce transition (3,000+ workers).

T0008_InternalControlOverReporting

Microsoft Sustainability Manager + SAP EHS, 30+ sites, SAP approval workflows, quarterly quality reviews, internal audit (10% sample), KPMG limited assurance (ISAE 3000, ISAE 3410 for GHG). COSO 2013 framework. ISO 9001:2015. Zero material weaknesses FY2025.

T0009_TransitionPlanDescription

ČEZ Clean Energy of Tomorrow 2030: 55%↓ GHG by 2030 (vs 2019: 31.1M tCO2e), 80% by 2040, net-zero 2050. Coal phase-out 2033 (8 plants, 4,500 MW). 6 GW renewables. Dukovany II nuclear (1,200 MW, CZK 180B, 2036). €15B+ investment 2024-2030. SBTi 1.5°C validated 2024. Internal carbon price €90/tCO2e. CEO 25% variable linked to climate.
